title: poitea gracilis
intro: Poitea gracilis, commonly known as the "Tupelo" or "Yellow Poplar", is a plant species native to the southeastern United States. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Poitea gracilis include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
